{
  "thinking": "Table's empty and the clock is running. A fish has a clear outline and a tail fin the judge can read, so I'll take the pad and sketch one, starting at the nose.",
  "say": "I'm grabbing the pad. I'll sketch a fish: start at the nose, one line over the top, one under, and a forked tail. Shout if you want a different animal.",
  "to": "everyone",
  "eagerness": 6,
  "point": [4, 10],
  "pad": "take",
  "sketch_clear": false,
  "sketch": [
    {"type": "curve", "points": [[4,10],[8,6],[14,5],[20,8],[22,10]]},
    {"type": "curve", "points": [[4,10],[8,14],[14,15],[20,12],[22,10]]},
    {"type": "line", "x0": 22, "y0": 10, "x1": 28, "y1": 5},
    {"type": "line", "x0": 22, "y0": 10, "x1": 28, "y1": 15},
    {"type": "circle", "cx": 8, "cy": 9, "r": 0.6},
    {"type": "label", "x": 8, "y": 8, "text": "eye"}
  ],
  "do": "stop",
  "notes": "Animal: fish, facing left. Stroke 1 = top body from nose (START, ~4,10) to tail base (~22,10). Stroke 2 = bottom body from nose to tail base. Strokes 3-4 = tail fork from tail base. Eye at ~8,9. Plan: trace 1 first, then 2, 3, 4. I hold the pad."
}
